title: Spotify Popularity Analysis.
description: Analyzed over 114,000 Spotify tracks to explore how audio features like danceability, energy, and tempo relate to song popularity. Used data visualization and machine learning to identify patterns and predict popularity.

title: Online Shopping Behavior Analysis.
description: Analyzed online shopping data from over 12,000 sessions to explore how browsing behavior affects purchase decisions. Focused on product page views, time spent browsing, and bounce rates.
